findings: No paper is involved (layer 1, no ETT label). About the ladder: the density causality decides all 20 causality-sort nodes. Everything holds except causally_arc_connected and absolutely_minimal: it has push-up (dens is additive), chronal neighbours (it contains the timelike line's chronology), and is future one-connected on every open set (its chronal curves are the timelike line's). So it is a Lean model, no-gluing only, of every causality-sort node but those two, the first such model in the library. Through the ladder it is causally open, causally plain and strongly causal with open neighbourhoods. The ladder's comment at programme/ladder.toml:243–251 credits it with three properties only.

The [[open]] chronal_neighbours → absolutely_minimal (programme/ladder.toml:4882–4885) is refuted in Lean, in the no-gluing reading, by Causal.densCausality_separates (conjuncts ChronalNeighbours and ¬ AbsolutelyMinimal). Until now it was only argued, through Galileo's spacetime and timelikeLineTop, whose lemmas are not in Lean. Its note's sentence 'The ladder's Lean models with chronal neighbours are all absolutely minimal' becomes false once the module graduates.

Tarentin also follows from chronal_neighbours (ladder edge chronal_neighbours ⇒ tarentin, Causal.Causality.ChronalNeighbours.tarentin), so the ErsNoArcWitness.data route the dispatch named is one of two. I used that route, as dispatched.

The dispatch's line numbers hold: SubExtensionAbstract.lean:213, :241, :321, :338; Ers464WithoutArc.lean:460, :625; GluingModels/NonMinimal.lean:88; the ladder comment at programme/ladder.toml:243–251 (the dispatch's 243–252, the last line being 'or [[fact]] entry changes.').

kb_proposals: The density causality decides every causality node: Causal.densCausality_separates (CausalScaffold.DensSeparates) proves 18 positive conjuncts and fails only causally_arc_connected and absolutely_minimal. The new facts are push-up (by dens_add), chronal neighbours and future one-connectedness. It is a no-gluing witness of [globally_hyperbolic, tarentin] ⇏ causally_arc_connected and the first Lean witness of chronal_neighbours ⇏ absolutely_minimal (T-abs-dens-separates).

A causality on ℝ whose ≪ goes up and contains the timelike line's has the timelike line's chronal curves (Causal.DensWitness.chronalCurveOn_iff_timelike), so it is future one-connected on every open set (futureOneConnectedOn_of_timelike) and has chronal neighbours (chronalNeighbours_of_timelike). These are the chronal twins of causalCurveOn_iff_timelike, and they apply to bigCausality and every IsMid D as well (T-abs-dens-separates).
